# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.1.1

Version 1.1.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.1.0

- **Room codes hold the port the router opened.** When the host's router opens UDP port 47070 for the room (UPnP,
  "(router port open)" on the multiplayer page), the room code now carries that port. Before, it carried the port
  STUN had seen, and some routers give the game's packets another outside port than the one they forward: then the
  code pointed at the wrong port and joining by code failed (`IP:47070` worked). Public rooms tell the DHT the same
  port, and a room still finds guests whose code was copied before the router answered.
- **A router behind another router** (or behind the carrier's NAT) opens a port that nobody outside can reach: the
  code then keeps the address and port the internet sees, and the multiplayer page says
  "(the router is behind another router: its open port is not used)" instead of "(router port open)".
- When no router answered UPnP, the next room asks again (before, only a restart did).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- Players in the same room should use the same version.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- What v1.1.0 brought (the menus, HD texture packs, multiplayer) is in the
  [v1.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.1.0); multiplayer over the internet
  in [docs/multiplayer.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/multiplayer.md).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- The multiplayer unit test, against a fake DHT node: with a forwarded port on a router whose address is the one the
  DHT sees, the room code holds that port and the public room's DHT announce gives it; with a router behind another
  one (its address private or another one), the code keeps the seen address and port. The whole test (joining with
  15% of all packets lost, joining by code through the DHT) passes as before.
- Two copies of the game (Linux) with two saved towns: the guest joins, receives the town, rides the train to the
  host's town, and both see each other, as with v1.1.0.
- No change to the decomp: the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.1.1, versionCode 10101).

## Known limitations

- Not tried between two real networks and routers; two routers that both change the port for every destination
  (symmetric NAT, some mobile networks) still cannot reach each other without a port forwarded by hand.
- Multiplayer shares the host's town only; see the [v1.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.1.0).
- Not yet tested much on real Windows or Android devices.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
